name: web-orange-pet-store-homepage-with-deals-banner-and-product-row
title: Orange Pet Store Deals Homepage
whatItIs: A wide rounded store page on an orange curve with a header of logo, orange Deals button, search and icons, pet category pills, a big orange hero 'Special deals for happy pets' with a dog and product bags, two stacked Dogs and Cats photo tiles and a Popular row of product cards with Top Seller tags.
whatItMeans: Warm orange and friendly pet photography feel cheerful and trustworthy, and cut-out products around the dog make the offer tangible.
techniques: Orange hero banner with cut-out products and pet
Stacked category photo tiles beside the hero
Small orange tags on product cards
White cards on a light grey ground

vocabulary.definition: A hero promoting discounts with a photo and CTA.
A rounded label with an icon for browsing a category.
A small label marking a popular product.
